from typing import Annotated
import cyclopts

@cyclopts.command
def deploy(
    target: str,
    token: Annotated[str, cyclopts.Parameter(env_var="DEPLOY_TOKEN", help="API token")]
) -> None:
    """Deploy to a target environment."""
    print(f"Deploying to {target} with token {token}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app = cyclopts.App()
    app.default = deploy
    app()
